description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for HTTP proxy functionality in a Git environment. It sets up testing scenarios such as cloning repositories through proxies with or without authentication, testing proxy prerequisites, and handling proxy URLs including SOCKS proxies and Unix sockets.

methods.name: start_socks
methods.description: Sets up a SOCKS proxy by creating a named pipe, running a Perl script to simulate the SOCKS proxy, and ensuring it is ready for use.

methods.name: old_libcurl_error
methods.description: Checks if the error log contains a specific message indicating that libcurl 7.84 or later is required to support paths in proxy URLs.
